rows.en:
Wait, geez, Klan-senpai,
you've got food all around your mouth...
I'll wipe it off, so lean in a little.
Oh, how thoughtful of you.

Don't "how thoughtful" me.
Ah, you splashed soup on your clothes too...
Whoa! When did that happen?!

(Klan-senpai really doesn't look
older than me at all...)
Ahh, that hit the spot!
That was delicious, wasn't it?
Mm, it certainly was.
Thanks for the treat today, Klan-senpai.
Mm. See you around.

(Hmm, I shouldn't say this after she treated me,
but Klan-senpai's childish on the inside too,
not just in her looks...)

(Sometimes I just get this craving
for Nyan-Nyan's Galaxy Ramen.)

(Aah~ Just thinking about it
is making me hungry...)
Are you here to eat at Nyan-Nyan too?

(Treating me to a meal...
That's Klan-senpai for you.)

(Klan-senpai really doesn't look
older than me at all...)

(Hmm, I shouldn't say this after she treated me,
but Klan-senpai's childish on the inside too,
not just in her looks...)

(I think I'll have lunch at Nyan-Nyan
today.)

(Huh? Who's that coming out
of Nyan-Nyan...?)
Hm? If it isn't \p.
Hello, Klan-senpai.

Mm, a fine greeting.
Are you here for lunch at Nyan-Nyan too?
I just finished eating myself.

Oh, that's right, I have something to do
after this. Sorry, but I'll be taking
my leave for today.
Okay, see you later.

(Too bad I couldn't eat with Klan-senpai
today. Oh well, I'll go enjoy a meal
at Nyan-Nyan myself.)

(Too bad I couldn't eat with Klan-senpai
today. Oh well, I'll go enjoy a meal
at Nyan-Nyan myself.)

(I promised to see a movie with
Klan-senpai today, but I never asked
which one we're seeing...)

Here before me, are you?
Commendable, very commendable.
Mm.

We promised to see a movie today,
but which one are we going to see?

That film they call a masterpiece,
"Do You Remember Love?"
DYRL for short. That's what we're seeing!

Umm... If I remember right, DYRL
is a movie from decades ago, isn't it?

It was first released in 2031,
but apparently it's getting
a revival screening.

Ooh, I've never seen it,
so I'm looking forward to it.

Hm, if we don't get going soon,
we'll be late for the showing.
Let's go!
Wow, that was great, wasn't it?

And at the end, the scene where Minmay
starts singing "Do You Remember Love?"...
Wait, are you listening? Klan-senpai?
The movie certainly was good...

Right?! And then when Hikaru flew
into Boddole Zer's ship......

I am...
I am not a child, I'm an adult!

(Oh, right, when we were buying
the tickets...)

What was with that clerk?! I clearly said
one adult, and they went and handed me
a child's ticket!!
(Well, I kind of get why, though...)

Any way you look at it, I am obviously
an adult! Honestly...

Now, now, Klan-senpai.
I know, let's go get some hot dogs.
Grr, I won't stand for thiiis!
So spiiiiicy!!!

Well, of course. You ordered something
as spicy as the Super Chili-Chili Dog...

Ugh... I shouldn't have forced myself
to act all grown-up......
You can say that again...
Ugh, so spicy...

\p,
get me a drink! Make it a sweet one!

(Honestly, I think it can't be helped
that people mistake you for a kid,
Klan-senpai...)

(I promised to see a movie with
Klan-senpai today, but I never asked
which one we're seeing...)

Ooh, I've never seen it,
so I'm looking forward to it.
Wait, are you listening? Klan-senpai?

(I came to see a movie with
Klan-senpai again, but...)

(Klan-senpai got mistaken for a kid again...
And this time, instead of getting angry
about it, she burst into tears...)

\p...
Is it really so strange for me
to want to pay the adult price?!

N-no, not at all!
You're right to insist on paying
the adult price, Klan-senpai.

That's right.
I haven't done a single thing wrong,
have I?

(Even so, I can't blame the clerk
for mistaking Klan-senpai for a kid...)

Mm. Well, there's no use dwelling
on the past forever.
Let's go eat some chili dogs.

(I hope she doesn't eat a spicy
chili dog and cry like last time...)

(Huh?
Am I turning into Klan-senpai's
guardian...?)

(Klan-senpai got mistaken for a kid again...
And this time, instead of getting angry
about it, she burst into tears...)

(Even so, I can't blame the clerk
for mistaking Klan-senpai for a kid...)

(Huh?
Am I turning into Klan-senpai's
guardian...?)

uncertain: c07762/c07763: Klan's abbreviation 'Ai-Obo' for the film rendered 'DYRL for short' (the usual English short form of Do You Remember Love?); film and song title from terms.json.
c07771: 'Boddole Zer-kan' rendered 'Boddole Zer's ship'; 'flew into' restored from the film (Hikaru's VF-1 enters the flagship) as the Japanese breaks off after the particle.
c07775/c07796/c07801: the ticket clerk is not identified, so 'they' / 'the clerk'.
c07760 'umu' (x4, Klan and Pinon) rendered 'Mm.'; c07791 'uu......' (x6, Klan crying here, Pinon elsewhere) rendered 'Uuu......'.
c07786: inner monologue addressed to Klan in the Japanese (polite 'omoimasu yo'), kept as 'you'.
